label: New window width
desc: How much of the screen a freshly opened window fills before you resize it

label: Widths Super+R steps through
desc: niri resizes by stepping a window through set widths instead of dragging. Super+R moves to the next one

label: Keep the focused window centred
desc: Whether niri slides the window you focus into the middle of the screen

label: Tab strip thickness
desc: Width of the strip that lists tabs when you stack a column into tabs with Super+T

label: Hide the tab strip for a lone window
desc: Only show the tab strip once a stacked column holds more than one window

label: Show where a dragged window will land
desc: Highlights the slot a window drops into while you drag it through the tiling

label: Urgent window colour
desc: The colour niri outlines a background window in when it wants your attention, like a finished download or a call

label: Left edge
desc: Room reserved along the left so a bar or dock there is never covered by a window

label: Right edge
desc: Room reserved along the right so a bar or dock there is never covered by a window

label: Top edge
desc: Room reserved along the top so a bar or dock there is never covered by a window

label: Bottom edge
desc: Room reserved along the bottom so a bar or dock there is never covered by a window

label: Server-side window frames
desc: Ask apps to drop their own title bars so niri draws the frame

label: Overview zoom
desc: How far the overview pulls back, lower fits more workspaces on screen

label: Hot corners
desc: Push the pointer into a screen corner to open the overview

label: Animation slowdown
desc: Stretches how long every animation takes. Above 1 is slower and calmer, below 1 is snappier

label: Skip hotkey overlay
desc: Don't show the keybind cheat sheet when the session starts

label: Save screenshots to
desc: Where the compositor's own screenshot lands. %Y, %m and %d become the date

label: Hide apps from screen sharing
desc: App IDs, comma separated, that niri blanks out of screen recordings and shares. Leave empty to hide nothing
